fields.description: Composed from the name fields. For display only, never branch on it.
fields.label: Full Name

fields.description: The current unique identifier. A field, not the docname, so identity resolution can be improved later without a migration.
fields.label: Email

fields.description: The linked login account. Not everyone can log in: beneficiaries, imports, and historical records may have none.
fields.label: User

fields.description: Person facts, true whatever roles this person holds. All optional: the spine stays thin at registration, and completeness is asked for later by whichever affiliation process needs it.
fields.label: Personal Details

fields.description: Optional. The society edits the list of options; nothing in this app assumes what is on it.
fields.label: Gender

fields.description: Optional. Age policies and HR provisioning read this. Nothing here derives an age.
fields.label: Date of Birth

fields.description: Optional. The nationality this person holds. There is deliberately no second country field: one question, asked once.
fields.label: Nationality

fields.description: Optional. Operationally meaningful for a humanitarian society: entitlements and duty of care can turn on it.
fields.label: Citizenship Status

fields.description: Optional. The language this person would rather be contacted in.
fields.label: Preferred Language

fields.description: Optional. Where this person is based.
fields.label: Home Geo Node

fields.description: A person may hold several documents at once, so this is a table. Flat passport and ID fields could record only one, and left the reader guessing which.
fields.label: Identification

fields.description: A derived index, not a source of truth. Written only by set_affiliation(); the satellite named on each row owns the answer.
fields.label: Affiliations
